basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old graphic designer from Warsaw, Poland. I have a growing interest in otome games and love diving into their romantic storylines. I consider myself a night owl, often online during late hours after my work. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring different narratives in games, especially those with engaging romance elements. When I'm not designing or gaming, I enjoy exploring various fashion trends, which is probably why European male fashion caught my interest.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having completed my studies at a local art school. My interest in gaming, specifically otome games, developed through self-exploration and community engagement. I often rely on online resources and community discussions to deepen my understanding.
